description: This Java class defines an abstract Akka actor named AbstractProxyActor, which serves as a base for command proxy actors within the Eclipse Ditto gateway proxy service. It manages subscription via pub/sub, handles common command messages (such as RetrieveStatistics), and sets up supervision strategies and message handling structure. The class also declares abstract methods for subclasses to specify command, response, and error behaviors.

classes.name: AbstractProxyActor
classes.description: An abstract base class for command proxy actors, providing shared logic for message handling, supervision, and actor reference management. It includes hooks for subclasses to define command, response, and error behaviors.

methods.name: AbstractProxyActor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the publisher-subscriber mediator and creating a statistics actor.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Defines the supervisor strategy for handling actor failures, with specific handling for NullPointerException and ActorKilledException.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Sets up the message handling logic including common command processing, delegation to subclass-specific behaviors, and exception handling.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the diagnostic logger instance for the actor.
